element.name: Static Web App
element.documentation: Azure Static Web App (Free tier) hosting the public/ frontend and its integrated Functions API (api/).

element.name: Azure SQL Server
element.documentation: Azure SQL Server (Microsoft.Sql/servers) — logical server hosting the appdb database and the Database Engine that executes its queries.

element.name: appdb
element.documentation: Free-tier serverless Azure SQL database (GP_S_Gen5). Holds dbo.DemoItems, created and seeded by the API on first request.

element.name: Database Config
element.documentation: Microsoft.Web/staticSites/config "appsettings" (main.bicep staticSiteAppSettings) — SQL_SERVER, SQL_DATABASE, SQL_USER, SQL_PASSWORD read by the Items API at runtime.

element.name: No-VNet Azure Network
element.documentation: Neither side has VNet integration or Private Link, so the Static Web App's egress to SQL (no VNet option on Free tier) and the SQL Server's public endpoint (publicNetworkAccess: Enabled) share this unisolated network plane. Not the open internet: access is additionally gated by the AllowAzureServices firewall rule, which admits any Azure tenant's services, not arbitrary internet hosts. (The specific access-control values live as props on SQL Server Interface below — they're that interface's gating policy, not an intrinsic property of this network.)

element.name: Internet
element.documentation: The genuinely open internet: unlike the no-VNet Azure network above, there's no firewall rule or Azure-tenant scoping here — any browser, anywhere, can reach the Static Web App's public HTTPS endpoint (Free tier has no private-endpoint option). This is the Visitor's ingress path, and the Static Web App's only direct egress/ingress boundary to the public internet as opposed to Azure's own network.

element.name: Items API
element.documentation: TypeScript Azure Functions API (api/src/functions/items.ts). The page calls /api/items; on first request it creates dbo.DemoItems and inserts three sample rows if the table is empty.

element.name: Frontend
element.documentation: Static browser app (public/index.html, public/app.js). Calls GET /api/items on page load and renders the returned DemoItem rows.

element.name: /api/items Interface
element.documentation: HTTP interface exposed by the Items API component for the frontend to call.

element.name: Initialize Demo Data
element.documentation: First-request setup inside getItems(): sp_getapplock, CREATE TABLE dbo.DemoItems if missing, INSERT 3 seed rows if empty.

element.name: Read Demo Items
element.documentation: SELECT Id, Name, Category FROM dbo.DemoItems ORDER BY Id, run every request after initialization.

element.name: DemoItems
element.documentation: dbo.DemoItems table — created and seeded by the Items API on first request.

element.name: SQL Server Interface
element.documentation: Interface exposed by Azure SQL Server for external communication — speaks TDS (Tabular Data Stream), the wire protocol Microsoft SQL Server and its client drivers (sys-mssql-driver) use to exchange queries and results.

element.name: Web App Interface
element.documentation: Interface exposed by the Static Web App for external communication.

element.name: SQL Server Database Engine
element.documentation: Database engine behind Azure SQL Server (Microsoft.Sql/servers) — executes the queries app-init-demo-data/app-read-demo-items send through the SQL Server Interface.

element.name: Static Web App Hosting Service
element.documentation: Azure Static Web App's own hosting service (Microsoft.Web/staticSites) — serves the Frontend's static files to the browser, and manages the Functions host's app settings (Database Config).

element.name: Node.js 24 Runtime
element.documentation: Server-side JS runtime hosting the compiled Items API (api/package.json engines.node >=24; see uml/structure/6-deployment.puml). Does not run the Frontend, which executes in the Visitor's browser, not this runtime.

element.name: mssql Driver (v11)
element.documentation: npm `mssql` package (api/package.json direct dependency) — the TDS client library getPool()/getItems() use to reach Azure SQL (see uml/structure/3-component.puml's "TDS (mssql)" interface).

element.name: Visitor
element.documentation: End user browsing the deployed Static Web App (8-use-case.puml).

element.name: View Demo Items
element.documentation: The Visitor loads the page and sees the demo item list (8-use-case.puml UC1, includes UC2 "Initialize demo data").

element.name: Website
element.documentation: The public URL/browser channel through which the Visitor reaches the app.

element.name: Frontend Interface
element.documentation: HTTP interface exposed by the Frontend component for the Visitor to interact with.

relationship.name: SQL_SERVER / SQL_DATABASE / SQL_USER / SQL_PASSWORD app settings
